args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while its docstring (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This broke the nightly build, since `tests/test_money.py` asserts half-even behavior (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Changes
- Switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed (sha `08d3cd5986`).
